import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static int myFind(String s, String sub, int start) {
        for (int i = start; i < s.length(); i++) {
            if (s.charAt(i) == sub.charAt(0)) {
                boolean ok = true;
                for (int j = 1; j < sub.length(); j++) {
                    if (i + j >= s.length() || s.charAt(i + j) != sub.charAt(j)) {
                        ok = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (ok) return i;
            }
        }
        return -1;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = scanner.nextLine();
        int atPos = myFind(s, "at", 1);
        StringBuilder s2 = new StringBuilder(s.substring(0, atPos) + '@' + s.substring(atPos + 2));
        int pos = myFind(s2.toString(), "dot", 1);
        while (pos != -1 && pos < s2.length() - 3) {
            s2.replace(pos, pos + 3, ".");
            pos = myFind(s2.toString(), "dot", pos + 1);
        }
        System.out.println(s2.toString());
    }
}
